name: Abandoned Magic Mages
summary: These are abandoned mages. Their robes are empty, but something inside them still glows ...
legend: Long after the last bell rang in the tower, the lanterns kept burning. No one remembers who taught there, only that the robes were never taken down from their hooks. Travellers say the robes walk now, dark as soot and lit from within by whatever spell their owners left unfinished. Frostweaver drifts through the cold halls with ice-blue light pooling in its palms. Ember Oracle smoulders in the cellars, reading futures in orange sparks. Somewhere beneath the library, the violet eyes of the Void Prophet keep watching a door no one else can see. The mages are gone, but their magic is not. And lately, more lights have begun to wake in the empty windows...

skins.name: Frostweaver
skins.story: A shadow-robed weaver of frost whose ice-blue eyes and palms still glow with the last winter spell of the tower.

skins.name: Ember Oracle
skins.story: Robed in charred red-brown, the Ember Oracle reads the future in orange sparks smouldering across its chest and hands.

skins.name: Void Prophet
skins.story: Wrapped in deep purple darkness, the Void Prophet stares through violet eyes at a door no one else can see.

skins.name: Nature Sage
skins.story: A moss-dark sage whose green glow winds across its chest like a living vine, still tending the overgrown tower gardens.

skins.name: Storm Archon
skins.story: Clad in midnight navy, the Storm Archon bears a crackling blue lightning bolt down its chest and thunder in its hands.

versions.note: The first five robes stir in the abandoned tower. Frostweaver, Ember Oracle, Void Prophet, Nature Sage and Storm Archon wake up, each glowing with its own lost element.

skins.name: Earth Warden
skins.story: Dark as buried soil, the Earth Warden guards the tower's foundations, amber light burning in its eyes, heart and fists.

skins.name: Tide Caller
skins.story: A deep-teal summoner whose cyan glow rises and falls like the tide it still calls through flooded corridors.

skins.name: Ash Prophet
skins.story: Charcoal-black and pale-eyed, the Ash Prophet glows a ghostly grey, foretelling what remains once every fire burns out.

skins.name: Rune Forger
skins.story: In crimson-dark robes, the Rune Forger still hammers forgotten runes with fists that glow forge-orange.

versions.note: Four more lights flicker on in the lower halls as Earth Warden, Tide Caller, Ash Prophet and Rune Forger rise from the forgotten workshops.

versions.title: The Hooded Circle

skins.name: Moonveil Hermit
skins.story: She hid in the empty observatory for a hundred nights, and now the pale crescent she prayed to shines on her own chest.

skins.name: Bloodthorn Hexer
skins.story: He traded his voice for a curse, so he hides his mouth behind a crimson veil and lets the thorns on his chest speak for him.

skins.name: Venom Mystic
skins.story: The serpents of the flooded cellar taught her their language, and the fangs on her cobra hood are the only thing they asked for in return.

versions.note: When the academy fell silent, three mages pulled up their hoods and kept practising in the dark: a hermit of the moon, a hexer of blood and a mystic who speaks with serpents.

versions.title: Crowns of the Fallen Tower

skins.name: Starfall Archmage
skins.story: He mapped every star from the top of the fallen tower, and the ones that fell from the sky now shine on the hat he pulls low over his golden eyes.

skins.name: Solar Magus
skins.story: The last keeper of the sun hall wears a golden circlet that still holds one morning of light, and he spends it a ray at a time.

skins.name: Crystal Enchantress
skins.story: She slept too long beside the tower’s power crystal, and when she woke, magenta shards had grown from her brow like a crown.

versions.note: High in the broken tower, three masters still wear the marks of their rank: a star-hatted archmage, a magus crowned with the sun and an enchantress grown out of crystal.

versions.title: Echoes of the Empty Academy

skins.name: Wisp Warden
skins.story: He died keeping the lanterns lit, and now his spectral halo and the lantern at his belt are the only lights that walk the empty corridors at night.

skins.name: Bonecrown Necromancer
skins.story: Crowned with the bones of the old headmasters, he keeps the crypt under the academy and lets no student rest until the lessons are finished.

skins.name: Gale Dervish
skins.story: She spins through the shattered windows of the academy, and the pale blue wind wrapped around her head never once touches the ground.

versions.note: Not everyone left the academy: a spirit still lights the halls, a necromancer guards the crypt below and a dervish rides the wind through the broken windows.

logoPrompt: Square logo: a single blocky Minecraft-style mage figure in near-black navy robes, glowing ice-blue eyes, an ice-blue glowing core on the chest and bright ice-blue light pooling in both hands, scattered small frost-blue glowing pixels on the robe, dramatic rim light and soft blue haze, pitch-dark background, centered composition, NO text.
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover: three blocky Minecraft-style mages standing side by side in the ruined hall of an abandoned magic tower at night. Left: Ember Oracle in dark reddish-brown robes with glowing orange eyes, chest sparks and hands. Center: Void Prophet in deep purple-black robes with glowing violet eyes, chest and hands. Right: Frostweaver in near-black navy robes with glowing ice-blue eyes, chest core and hands. Broken bookshelves, cracked arched windows with moonlight, floating dust, coloured glow reflecting on the stone floor. Big stylised glowing letters at the top reading "Abandoned Magic Mages".
